description: This file defines the interface IStateObserver for subscribing to application state change notifications within the Rialto server manager service. It declares a pure virtual method 'stateChanged' that must be implemented by clients to react to state changes, and includes necessary headers and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IStateObserver
classes.description: An interface for clients to implement in order to receive notifications about application state changes from RialtoSessionServer.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: A pure virtual method that must be implemented by subclasses to handle application state change events, receiving the application ID and the new session server state.
